note_en: 连…都/也… stresses that something holds even in the most extreme case: 连一个电话号码里多出来的空格都没放过 "she didn't let even an extra space in a phone number slip past." 连 moves that extreme example forward, and 都 (or 也) before the verb confirms it is included. The same frame from the other side: 他连最简单的表格都填错了三次 "he got even the simplest form wrong three times."
